card.name: Abdominal pain and linking words in clinical lists
card.fires_on: The word abdominal right before pain in lists of symptoms or diagnoses, and also small linking words or punctuation (and, of, commas, periods) inside dosing and warning lists.

modes.label: Abdominal before pain
modes.description: The word abdominal after 'with' or 'and' when a symptom list is being given.
modes.example: Consider typhlitis in patients with fever, neutropenia and<< abdominal>> pain.

modes.label: Joiners in dosing lists
modes.description: A period, comma, or 'of' within dosing schedules, severity grades or headings.

modes.label: Other condition words
modes.description: Condition words like acute or ulcer in the middle of a condition name or list.

card.plain: It lights up on the word abdominal before pain and on small joining marks in drug-label lists.
